pr_title: Name the lens beside each note

comments.comment: renderNotes prints each note once per lens, which the base design's High signal, low noise section forbids: a fact is stated once in the comment, never once per lens.
comments.failureScenario: Eight lenses run, and each carries the note `callers unavailable for src/a.ts`. The base prints that note once. The head prints it eight times, once under each lens name, so the comment grows by seven lines that tell the reader nothing new.
